title: Tatung secures 345 kV transformer order in US, lands first modular AIDC turnkey project
html:
Tatung has secured orders for 345kV large transformers in Texas and California and won its first turnkey edge AI data center order, the company said at its joint investor conference for the third quarter of 2026 on November 26...

The article requires paid subscription. Subscribe Now
summary: Tatung stated that power, computing, and land were its three main growth drivers in 3Q26, noting that it has secured a 345 kV transformer order in the US and its first modular AIDC turnkey project.
